question: H100 SXM5 的标称显存带宽为 3352 GB/s（HBM3），H100 PCIe 版本的标称显存带宽同样为 3352 GB/s，显存子系统无差异，但 PCIe 版在大规模分布式推理中互联效率较低 [待核验]。

sources.title: NVIDIA H100 SXM5 80 GB Specs | TechPowerUp GPU Database
sources.snippet: NVIDIA has paired 80 GB HBM3 memory with the H100 SXM5 80 GB, which is connected using a 5120-bit memory interface. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 1590 MHz, which can be boosted up to 1980 MHz, memory is running at 1313 MHz (5.3 Gbps effective).

sources.title: NVIDIA H100 SXM5 64 GB Specs | TechPowerUp GPU Database
sources.snippet: The H100 SXM5 64 GB is a data center GPU by NVIDIA, launched on March 21st, 2023. Built on the 5 nm process, and based on the GH100 graphics processor, in its GH100-881-A1 variant, the GPU is not designed for gaming: it offers no DirectX support and targets AI and HPC workloads instead.
